chunks: Then, what will make you comprehend what the Day of Judgement is?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Ma adarak' in Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question underscores the transcendence of the Day of Reckoning beyond human cognitive limits, inviting believers to rely on divine revelation for understanding its realities. It serves as a spiritual catalyst for self-accountability (muhasabah), reminding the faithful that the weight of this day necessitates preparation through faith and righteous deeds.
